<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify numeric indicator columns (exclude id/name/year columns)
id_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

# Keep raw values for profile computation (before any imputation/scaling)
raw_values = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Median imputation for clustering
df_imputed = df[indicator_cols].copy()
medians = df_imputed.median()
df_imputed = df_imputed.fillna(medians)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled = scaler.fit_transform(df_imputed.values)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled)

df['cluster_id'] = labels

# Write city clusters
out1 = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'cluster_id']].copy()
out1.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Write cluster profiles: mean of raw indicator values per cluster (non-missing only)
profile_rows = []
for cid in sorted(df['cluster_id'].unique()):
    mask = df['cluster_id'] == cid
    row = {'cluster_id': int(cid)}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        row[col] = raw_values.loc[mask, col].mean()
    profile_rows.append(row)

profile_df = pd.DataFrame(profile_rows)
profile_df.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
